Two corrections to the text; everything else I checked is right.
  > 
  > 1. results.tex, coverage paragraph: 'On these cells, by graph family, coverage is lowest on Stanford3 (0.52) …' follows the sentence about cells with |bias|/SD < 0.25, so it reads as the quartile subset. The family numbers are on all 1800 figure cells (HC0: Stanford3 0.522, ego-Facebook 0.663, WS 0.817; BA 0.744, DCSBM 0.754, ER 0.800, SBM 0.757; all 0.736). Please say 'On all 1800 cells, by graph family' (not 'these cells'). I recomputed them from the delivered cells.parquet with claims.c8_cov_family_figure; the table c8_coverage_figure_by_family.csv comes with my next export. Do not cite c8_coverage_by_family.csv (a different population: s = 0.5 only).
  > 2. results.tex line 13: 'median absolute gap is 0.39--0.53 of the Monte Carlo half-width'. On the six mechanisms (1224 cells), with finite-n centring the medians are 0.40, 0.41, 0.40, 0.53, 0.41, 0.41; without it 0.40, 0.45, 0.40, 0.53, 0.53, 0.41. 0.39 is the null column's value (0.387), which is not in the 1224. Say 0.40--0.53. Max gaps 0.016--0.052 (without centring) are right.
  > 
  > Checked and correct: 85.1% / 86.7% of 1224 (c2_prediction_check, six mechanisms; the 1292 includes the 68 null cells), (e) 81% -> 90%; the C3 zero 0.397 [0.393, 0.401] against the population-OLS prediction 0.397; (d) bias 0.242, 0.731, 0.250 at p = s = 1/2; the absolute-R2 sentence on the 1224 cells.
  > 
  > Pending from me, not in this candidate: the GNN baseline on the 14 Tier A cells and the unnormalised HT columns for the cluster designs (jobs queued on a saturated host). When they land the 'graph neural networks are not run' sentences (design.tex, discussion.tex) will need to change; I will say so in experiment-repo#11. I will update REPRODUCE.md section 7 in the same delivery (its 'no GNN … cluster HT not implemented' line is stale: the cluster designs already use the Hajek form).
